question: Find the value of [(50 div 5) timesleft{(72)/(3)+(12)/(1) times(8-7)right}]
solution:
**Given:**

Find the value of [(50 div 5) timesleft{(72)/(3)+(12)/(1) times(8-7)right}]

**Formula used:**

Use BODMAS rule for calculation

**Calculations:**

[(50 ÷ 5) × {(72)/(3) + (12)/(1) × (8 - 7)}]

⇒ [(50 ÷ 5) × {24 + 12 × 1}]

⇒ [10 × {24 + 12}]

⇒ [10 × 36]

⇒ 360

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
